picks.editorial_note: A $14.2M DOE Genesis Mission award tasks Brookhaven National Laboratory and Stony Brook with building a foundation AI model for the national electric grid — a flagship federal bet on AI infrastructure for energy resilience.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health's new AWS-powered Innovation Hub pairs cloud/AI infrastructure with clinical expertise, the kind of academia-industry-health system alliance that can reshape medical education and care delivery at scale.
picks.title: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health to Launch Innovation Hub, Powered by Amazon Web Services

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky joins a national team negotiating a DOE award for the 'Mine of the Future' initiative, extending AI-driven modernization into critical minerals and mining — a strategically important but often overlooked sector.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: NIST's $30M+ investment across 12 Manufacturing Extension Partnership centers helps small and mid-size manufacturers nationwide adopt AI and robotics, a broad federal push with direct economic impact.
picks.title: NIST Awards More Than $30 Million for MEP Centers in 11 States and Puerto Rico

picks.editorial_note: Michigan State's beam-signing for the Leinweber Center for Engineering and Digital Innovation signals a major capital commitment to interdisciplinary AI and quantum research infrastructure.
picks.title: MSU celebrates future Leinweber Center for Engineering and Digital Innovation with beam signing

picks.editorial_note: A Virginia Tech alum's startup MorphLabs is building noninvasive AI brain-computer bridges to give amputees control over prosthetics — a real-world translation of AI research into assistive medical technology.
picks.title: Engineering alum's medical startup aims to empower amputees with AI-linked prosthetics
picks.university: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University

picks.editorial_note: University of Houston chemists are combining AlphaFold AI screening with quantum sensing to fight antibiotic-resistant superbugs like MRSA, a novel cross-disciplinary approach to a major public health threat.
picks.title: University of Houston Awarded $1.26M NIH Grant to Outsmart Superbugs | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: Florida State's $1.96M NIH New Innovator Award funds a generative AI-powered behavioral health intervention, reflecting growing federal investment in AI applied to mental health care.
picks.title: FSU College of Nursing receives $1.9 million award to advance AI-powered behavioral healthcare

picks.editorial_note: A UMass Amherst national poll finding only 11% of Americans support local AI data center construction, with 65% opposed across party lines, is a striking signal of the public backlash shaping AI infrastructure policy debates.
picks.title: Just 1 in 9 Americans Support AI Data Center Construction in their Local Communities, According to New UMass Amherst Poll | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn University's DeepGI, an AI system assisting colonoscopy screening for colorectal cancer, won a national public-sector excellence award, underscoring real clinical adoption of diagnostic AI in Southeast Asia.
picks.title: Chula Medical Innovation Receives Excellence Award 2026 - Chulalongkorn University
